sourceRefs.locator: Attestation 933, Gregory, Glory of the Confessors 104: he went to Radegund’s community at Poitiers on hearing of her death.
IX.39, opening: Clotild, Basina, the group’s departure from Poitiers and appeal to Gregory in Tours, followed by the bishop’s version of his answer.

summary.de: Der Bischof von Tours berichtet über seine Reise nach Poitiers beim Tod Radegundes und über die Frauen aus Poitiers, die ihn in Tours aufsuchten.
summary.en: The bishop of Tours recounts travelling to Poitiers when Radegund died and later meeting the women of Poitiers who came to Tours.
